name: Alchemist Formula Artificer
body:
Formula artificers devote their alchemical talents to unraveling the workings of magic items, blending metamagic principles into their extracts, and using their prepared formulae as fuel.

Artifice Study (Ex)

At 1st level, a formula artificer can attempt to identify a magic item and recognize its magic auras without the aid of detect magic so long as they are examining the item by touch a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Intelligence modifier. Additionally, a formula artificer can expend a second use of artifice study to take 10 on the skill check, even if they are threatened or distracted.

While using this ability, spells or effects that change or disguise magic auras can fool the formula artificer as well. However, they are entitled to a Will save against such effects as if they had cast identify.

A formula artificer adds a bonus equal to 1/2 their class level (minimum +1) to Use Magic Device checks to any magic item for which they have previously successfully identified its properties with artifice study.

This ability replaces poison use.

Normally, Knowledge (arcana) is used to identify magical auras and Spellcraft is used to identify properties of magic items. We did not specify these skills in artifice study because sometimes a character has the ability to use other skills or methods instead when attempting such identifications. In such cases, artifice study still works as intended.

Metamagic Studies: Starting at 2nd level, a formula artificer’s experimentation with arcane magic has taught them how to blend select metamagic feats with their extracts. A formula artificer gains formulaic metamagic as a bonus discovery at 2nd, 5th, and 10th level; they do not need to meet the prerequisites for this discovery. This ability replaces poison resistance +2, poison resistance +4, and poison immunity.

Retain Charge (Su)

At 6th level, a formula artificer has developed the ability to expend their prepared extract slots on certain types of magic items. This ability is as per the artificer’s retain charge ability, except that it uses the formula artificer’s prepared extracts instead of prepared spells. This ability replaces swift poisoning.

Metamagic Channel (Su)

At 8th level, a formula artificer can now apply certain metamagic modifications with external aid. A formula artificer gains metamagic conduit as a bonus discovery; they do not need to meet the prerequisites for this discovery. This ability replaces poison resistance +6.
